test_title: PYST 55: SSC GD Constable - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on: 10th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: A person invested (1)/(2) of his capital at 6%, (1)/(4) at 8% and the remaining at 12%. If his annual income is Rs. 528, then find the capital.
solution:
Given:

A person invested (1)/(2) of his capital at 6%, (1)/(4) at 8% and the remaining at 12%.

His annual income is Rs. 528.

Concept used:

Simple Interest, SI = (P × R × T)/100

Amount = P + SI

where, P = Principal amount, R = Rate of interest per year

T = Time in years

Calculation:

Let the capital be Rs. 8x.

Interest on (1)/(2) of his capital at 6% = (8x/2 × 6 × 1)/100

⇒ Rs. 6x/25

Interest on (1)/(4) of his capital at 8% = (8x/4 × 8 × 1)/100

⇒ Rs. 4x/25

Remaining capital = 8x - 4x - 2x = Rs. 2x

Interest on his remaining capital at 12% = (2x × 12 × 1)/100

⇒ Rs. 6x/25

According to the question,

6x/25 + 4x/25 + 6x/25 = 528

⇒ 16x/25 = 528

⇒ x = (528 × 25)/16

⇒ x = 825

⇒ 8x = 6600 (Multiplying 8 on both sides)

∴ The capital was Rs. 6600.
